approval_ref: FR-CLASS-001 explicitly requires users to view and correct classification, and the active goal requires continued RFI/Submittal/Email adaptability and accuracy.
notes: The workflow relationship API and page are currently read-only, so a deterministic misclassification cannot be corrected by the reviewer.
Add a current-run workflow-classification overlay with optimistic versioning and append-only events; never overwrite parser summaries, evidence, extracted candidates or source files.
Allow DETECTED reset, OTHER, exact RFI and exact Submittal values. Validate type-specific identifier, role and canonical status fields before storage.
Display detected and effective values clearly in English; corrections do not infer authority and do not trigger parsing, extraction, model calls or a new run.

Completed offline with 659 Python tests, 24 UI tests, 11 deployment tests and 14 browser regression checks; browser validation made zero model calls and zero external requests. Full checks, specification sync, dependency validation and the 377-file source manifest passed.
title: Add auditable workflow classification corrections
objective: Let a reviewer correct the effective RFI/Submittal workflow classification for one document in one completed run through a versioned, auditable overlay without mutating detected evidence or starting model work.
